description: The 'Run New Analysis' page: a PipelineConfig-bound form, a Start button, and the live progress panel once a run is active. No FORMULATION.md-governed value is ever exposed as an editable field here (ui invariant).
signature: def render_new_analysis_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, settings: Settings) -> None
docstring:
Render the run-trigger page.

Args:
    conn: This page's own short-lived connection, opened by main/build_navigation's dispatch for this rerun only.
    settings: Loaded once in main and passed down.

Behavior:
    - Shows the current parameters_version (config.parameters_version(settings.parameters_path)) read-only, with a note that FORMULATION.md is where the actual values live and this page cannot change them.
    - A form exposing exactly PipelineConfig's fields: max_catalog_pages (optional int, for a smoke test), request_budget_override (optional int), notes (optional text). start_stage is NOT exposed here -- it is fixed to ACQUISITION for a brand-new run; starting from a later stage is only ever done via Resume on an existing run from the Past Analyses page.
    - The Start button is disabled while orchestration.active_run_ids() is non-empty (ADR-001: only one writer), with a tooltip explaining why.
    - On Start: config = PipelineConfig(**form values); run_id = orchestration.start_pipeline_async(settings.db_path, config, settings=settings); st.session_state['active_run_id'] = run_id; st.session_state['last_event_id'] = 0; st.session_state['event_log'] = [].
    - If st.session_state['active_run_id'] is set (a run was started, possibly in an earlier rerun of this same page), render_progress_panel(settings.db_path, st.session_state['active_run_id']) is called below the form.
postconditions: No PipelineConfig field is ever populated from a FORMULATION.md-governed value; the form's field set is exactly {max_catalog_pages, request_budget_override, notes}
Start is unclickable (disabled) whenever orchestration.active_run_ids() is non-empty at render time
Only SESSION_KEYS entries are written: active_run_id, last_event_id, event_log

edge_cases.input: A run is already active (started from this page or another tab)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Start is disabled; the progress panel for that active run is shown instead, even if it was started from a different browser tab, since active_run_ids() is process-wide, not session-scoped

edge_cases.input: Start clicked with an invalid form value (e.g. request_budget_override='abc')
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Streamlit's own number_input widget prevents non-numeric entry at the widget level; no invalid PipelineConfig is ever constructed

edge_cases.input: The page is opened for the first time in a fresh session (no active_run_id in session_state yet)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: session_state['active_run_id'] is treated as None/absent; only the form is shown, no progress panel
the exception is caught and shown as an inline error message, not an uncaught traceback; session_state is not updated on this path

unit_tests.name: test_form_exposes_only_pipelineconfig_fields
unit_tests.description: AppTest inspection of the rendered form's inputs matches exactly max_catalog_pages, request_budget_override, notes.
unit_tests.expected: no other field present, no FORMULATION.md value editable

unit_tests.name: test_start_disabled_when_run_active
unit_tests.description: With orchestration.active_run_ids() stubbed non-empty, the Start button is disabled.

unit_tests.name: test_start_click_sets_session_state_and_starts_pipeline
unit_tests.description: Clicking Start with valid form values calls start_pipeline_async once and sets all three SESSION_KEYS.
unit_tests.expected: start_pipeline_async called once; session_state has active_run_id, last_event_id=0, event_log=[]

unit_tests.name: test_start_failure_shown_inline_not_raised
unit_tests.description: A stubbed start_pipeline_async raising an exception results in an inline error, not an AppTest exception.
unit_tests.expected: no exception escapes; error message rendered
